summary: A conversion-focused niche landing page for real estate agents who need an AI that actually operates their CRM, MLS portals, email, and calendar. Super is positioned as the sharper alternative for durable computer-use workflows thanks to its reusable computer-use cache — built for repeated follow-ups, listing updates, and scheduling.
